g.text: Network & port exposure — what listens, what is published, what is authenticated
Docker publishes to 0.0.0.0 unless a bind address is given
INTERNAL — compose network only (no host port)
EGRESS — outbound from the orchestrator / sync-worker
The single highest-severity fact in this audit.
"NOT fine if the port is published to a network you
do not control — see the compose port bindings."
The compose port binding is `"8080:8080"`, which
The precondition the code relies on is not met.
This is the pattern the vLLM services should follow.
All user-influenced outbound fetches funnel through
DNS resolved and checked before connect, every
redirect hop re-validated, body + time capped.
Residual gap: resolve-then-connect is a TOCTOU
web search · URL analysis · repo fetch
SSRF guard + 3 redirect hops + size cap
